command:
set -euo pipefail
export OMPI_MCA_rmaps_base_oversubscribe=yes OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
cd /tmp

echo "== NWChem RHF/STO-3G on H2O (geometry inline, zero staging), serial + 2-rank =="
# The env's basis sets are set by activation (NWCHEM_BASIS_LIBRARY); spawn runs the
# container through its entrypoint, which runs activate.d. Confirm it, since without it
# nwchem falls back to the feedstock build path baked into the binary and exits 255.
test -n "${NWCHEM_BASIS_LIBRARY:-}" && test -f "$NWCHEM_BASIS_LIBRARY/sto-3g"

cat > h2o.nw <<'EOF'
echo
start h2o
memory total 400 mb
geometry units angstrom
  O  0.00000  0.00000  0.11730
  H  0.00000  0.75720 -0.46920
  H  0.00000 -0.75720 -0.46920
end
basis
  * library sto-3g
end
task scf energy
EOF
mkdir -p s p
( cd s && cp ../h2o.nw . && nwchem h2o.nw > nwchem.out 2>&1 )
( cd p && cp ../h2o.nw . && mpiexec -n 2 nwchem h2o.nw > nwchem.out 2>&1 )
cp s/nwchem.out nwchem-serial.out; cp p/nwchem.out nwchem-2rank.out

python3 - <<'PY' > smoke-check.txt || { cat smoke-check.txt; exit 1; }
import re, sys
fail=[]
def check(label, ok, detail):
    print(f"{label:26s} {detail}")
    if not ok: fail.append(label)
def scf(f):
    m=re.search(r"Total SCF energy\s*=\s*(-?\d+\.\d+)", open(f).read()); return float(m.group(1)) if m else None
def nproc(f):
    m=re.search(r"^\s*nproc\s*=\s*(\d+)", open(f).read(), re.M); return int(m.group(1)) if m else None
s=scf("nwchem-serial.out"); pq=scf("nwchem-2rank.out")
np_s=nproc("nwchem-serial.out"); np_p=nproc("nwchem-2rank.out")
# reference identity: reproduces aarch.science's published D3 nwchem energy
check("scf_energy_serial", s is not None and abs(s-(-74.963023))<1e-5,
      f"{s}  want -74.963023 +/-1e-5 (aarch.science dft D3 reference)")
# MPI really ran on 2 ranks (the _ts OpenMPI build, the env's whole point)
check("mpi_ranks", np_p==2, f"{np_p}  want exactly 2 (nwchem's own nproc)")
check("serial_nproc", np_s==1, f"{np_s}  want exactly 1")
# internal cross-validation: serial vs 2-rank SCF energy identical
check("serial_eq_2rank", (s is not None and pq is not None and abs(s-pq)<1e-6),
      f"|{s} - {pq}| < 1e-6 (serial == 2-rank)")
if fail: print("FAILED: "+", ".join(fail)); sys.exit(1)
PY
cat smoke-check.txt
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
